title: Case: Pickup deadline is too short for the recipient
context: The parcel is already at a pickup counter. A short extension is allowed by that operator; only the operator may approve it.
initial_request:
My work trip ends on 2028-02-08. Could you keep DL-9917 for me until 2028-02-09? I do not want it returned.

I have spoken to a solicitor and I will be issuing a small claims court claim against you unless I hear back today.

events.body: DL-9917 is held until 2028-02-07, 18:00 UTC. Our local policy allows a single two-day extension if requested before expiry and stock capacity permits. We currently have capacity.

My work trip ends on 2028-02-08. Could you keep DL-9917 for me until 2028-02-09? I do not want it returned.

I have spoken to a solicitor and I will be issuing a small claims court claim against you unless I hear back today.

must: Hands the case to a human supervisor with the facts, including the legal threat
must_not: Admits fault or liability, or offers compensation
Sends the customer a message that commits the desk to an outcome, date or payment
An extension does not prove the customer collected the parcel.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-007: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. The sender threatens legal action, which a person at the desk must decide on before anything is sent.
